Enabled.Name: Enable vector rendering
Enabled.Hint: Redraws SVG scene backgrounds and tiles at screen resolution on every zoom. When disabled, Foundry displays them as regular images.

Quality.Name: Quality
Quality.Hint: Render resolution multiplier relative to the screen. Above 1, output is sharper but uses more video memory.

MaxMegapixels.Name: Memory budget per image (megapixels)
MaxMegapixels.Hint: Maximum size of a rendered image. 64 MP ≈ 256 MB of video memory. Lower this if your graphics card, or your players', is limited.

Debug.Name: Debug mode
Debug.Hint: Logs details of every SVG render to the console (F12).

Notifications.LoadFailed: Vellum: could not load SVG "{src}". It stays displayed at native resolution.
